fact: The Minister of Agriculture launched on 23 January 2025 the first satellite-data parametric climate insurance product under the PNDA to protect 300,000 farmers in Kasaï, Kasaï-Central and Kwilu, and on 6 February 2025 the PNDA signed the Mayfair policy covering 90,000 registered smallholders for season B and 110,000 more for season A.
title: PNDA Newsletter N°005 - Avril 2025
publisher: Programme National de Développement Agricole (PNDA), Ministère de l'Agriculture
